description: Change the bet to a specific denomination. Takes whichever path the build offers: open the denomination list and tap a row, or — when there is no list (profile.HAS_BET_POPUP is False) — step the stake control until it lands. Places NO bet, so there is no stream data; exposes facts.picked_bet / picked_index and what it ACTUALLY landed on (landed_bet / landed_index / bet_changed), plus the video window for an AI check that the on-screen amount matches.

cases.title: Changing the bet moves it to the level the player picked

video.prompt:
Grandma Pets is a 5-reel, 4-row slot. In this clip the player changes the bet — watch the bet amount displayed on the main screen.
(1) bet_changes: does the bet amount on the main screen change during the clip? (2) final_bet: read the bet shown at the END of the clip, exactly as printed, as a string. (3) ui_broken: is anything overlapping, cut off, placeholder or visibly broken?
notes: one short sentence on anything the questions above do not cover.

data.notes: The player opens the Bet Options menu and changes the bet from 0.10 to 7.00.
data.reason: At the start of the video (00:00), the bet is 0.10. A menu opens at 00:01, and at 00:03, the player selects the 7.00 option. By the end of the clip (00:06 onwards), the main screen reflects this change, showing a bet of 7.00.
